name: Dispersing Bullet
text:
Ammunition sling bullet

Activate 1 (manipulate)

---
The metals used to forge this lead ball were taken from a variety of continents and barely stay together. When an activated dispersing bullet hits a target, the bullet scatters into a sphere of metal shards as the metals try to return to their places of origin. All creatures in a 10-foot emanation around the target of the attack (not including the target) must succeed at a DC 21 Fortitude save save or be pushed 10 feet from the target (15 feet on a critical failure).
